purpose: We develop hospital planning software and want to train a bed-occupancy forecasting model. Aggregates will not give us the temporal patterns we need, so we need visit-level records.
question: Provide pseudonymised inpatient encounters from 2025 with patient ID, hospital, start date and end date.
definitions: Cohort = inpatient stays whose start_date is in 2025.
Report the number of stays you would make available.
